rows.reviewer_attack: The framework is only a hand-written rule table.
rows.claim_boundary: Claim non-redundant audit value, not superior prediction.

rows.reviewer_attack: The result depends on arbitrary thresholds.
rows.claim_boundary: Report safe and dangerous regions; do not claim universal threshold robustness.

rows.reviewer_attack: The gate only works on hand-crafted synthetic cases.
rows.claim_boundary: Use SciFact as external claim-auditing evidence, not SOTA verification.

rows.reviewer_attack: The method mistakes correlation for causal direction.
rows.claim_boundary: Use Tuebingen to block causal overclaims, not to claim causal-discovery performance.

rows.reviewer_attack: The manuscript says more than the artifacts support.
rows.claim_boundary: Keep manuscript wording tied to executable claim contracts.

rows.reviewer_attack: The LLM becomes an unverified judge of scientific claims.
rows.claim_boundary: Use LLMs only for candidate extraction and conservative wording support.

rows.reviewer_attack: Borderline evidence is forced into binary support.
rows.claim_boundary: Uncertain claims remain uncertain; uncertainty cannot become support.
